profile.headline: Senior Front-End Developer at National Funding
profile.summary:
I have many skills in web development and I am constantly finding and learning new, fun and modern development functions and designs.  

I particularly enjoy optimizing, automating, and solving issues across all browsers and environments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Complete creation of Wordpress theme and landing pages
- Various aspects of front end and back end programming
- API integrations with marketing platforms
- Apache server maintenance
- SEO

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
-   Developing websites from the ground up.
-   Coding designs from Photoshop mockups
-   Creating responsive web design including media queries
-   Experience with Bootstrap framework (2.3.2 and 3), WordPress, Photoshop and social media
-   Knowledge of HTML, CSS, PHP, Javascript, SEO
-   Utilize strong organizational skills and attention to detail 
-   Communicate and convey information to both technical and non-technical clients
-   Maintain a continuing education on developing technologies

positions.title: Proof of Claim Specialist
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
-   Processing claims of ownership and liability
-   Intricate data entry for all financial processes of bankruptcy
-   Processing bankruptcy and foreclosure referrals for banks including FNMA and FHLMC
-   Operating remotely from firms west coast headquarters to east coast office
-   Close interaction with attorneys regarding filing and processing
-   Conducting Proof of Claim referrals for clients in California, Alabama, and Tennesee
-   Drafting emails for both clients and attorneys
-   Familiar with LPS Newtrack desktop, Prolaw, and Citrix	
-   Working with management to streamline west and east coast remote operations
